create_instructions_curriculum: create an InstructionsCurriculum instance with a config dict specifying curriculum type and training parameters
initialize_curricula: initialize curriculum trajectory bins by distance, instructions, or both for progressive training
sample_trajectory: sample a trajectory from the curriculum based on elapsed training time and curriculum strategy
update_ratio_training: update the fraction of training curriculum progress based on elapsed wall-clock time since start
configure_frame_cap_curriculum: configure a curriculum that gradually increases the frame cap from an initial limit to a maximum
